# Synthetic input suites

Generated by `cargo xtask gen-data` from `xtask/src/data.rs`; do not edit by hand.
Each suite is a pure function of its seed (`ChaCha8Rng::seed_from_u64`);
`cargo xtask gen-data --check` verifies these files (`docs/spec/harness.md`, R4).
A case uses a suite by listing its file in `inputs`; `cargo xtask oracle generate`
copies it into the case directory.

| File | Seed | SHA-256 | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|

| `ties.dat` | 2 | `d167c6e821154d24deb4d32f3b3183e3bc1f56a790e6140c12ec26f44b62d313` | 40 points whose values take only 4 levels, so most are tied: nscore/backtr tie handling (GSLIB's random despiking, F-005). |
